dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: Really? That sounds like it'd make for a lovely scene... In that case, I do hope that you can bless her flowers with a song.

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: I'd love to help myself, but it seems that deep subject matter knowledge will be required...

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: Would you be willing to visit her garden <color=#00E1FFFF>at the village entrance</color> and give her some suggestions?
